description: This source file defines a React component for managing subtitle files within a web application. It provides functionalities to list, view, edit, save, and download subtitles, interacting with backend APIs.

methods.name: ManageSubtitlesPage()
methods.description: React component that manages the UI for listing, editing, and downloading subtitles, utilizing React hooks for state and side effects.

methods.name: load
